exposure_check.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id
exposure_check.scope: All selected original-family identities have no recorded project model use; absence from public pretraining or unrecorded external work is not asserted.

method_semantics_documentation_only.interpretation: Documentation only, not a method-overrides runtime schema. Exact registered method names and frozen source/config/manifest identities bind the actual implementations.

all_final_learners.policy: Same training-support NumericQuantileClipper for all four method final learner pipelines. Numeric bounds are fitted on the current training partition only, before downstream imputation/scaling/native handling; no held-out quantiles.

baseline-robust.description: Reviewed raw predictors with the same final training-support clipping as all three engineered methods.

featcopilot-frequency-aligned-robust.aligned_search: Existing aligned path evaluates FE+learner pipelines for each of the same three settings, and refits selected features using the chosen training-only setting. Not a permanently middle-setting selector.

openfe-inductive-native-robust.generation: Identical existing first-order full numeric/categorical candidate generation, training-only inductive DAG transforms and native selected width. Existing training-median generation preparation; original numeric missingness restored afterward.
openfe-inductive-native-robust.not_claimed: No clipping retrofit into OpenFE internal ranking, no stock transductive transform, no new operator filtering.

autofeat-native-robust.generation: Identical existing native generation/selection and train-fitted one-hot adapter; original numeric missingness restored before the matched final learner.

method_semantics_documentation_only.catboost_representation_caveat: The existing candidate-selection CatBoost estimator drops cat_features and is evaluated through numeric candidate-engine preprocessing. Final CatBoost retains native categorical handling with the shared final clipper. This known mismatch is disclosed; no runtime rewrite or categorical conversion experiment.
method_semantics_documentation_only.failure_policy: No native-reference error-to-baseline substitution, narrowing of feature output, retries with easier algorithms, or outcome-based dataset replacement.

claim_gate.family_loss: Arithmetic mean primary loss over ALL three preregistered splits for each family/method/learner; any missing/nonfinite split makes that paired family-method loss incomplete.
claim_gate.aggregation: Equal-family mean/median relative gains per classification/regression x learner stratum; report family raw losses separately. Do not pool unscaled losses across tasks.
claim_gate.positive_vs_raw: Strictly positive mean G versus baseline-robust in EACH of eight task/learner strata.
claim_gate.family_harm: No family/learner loss worsening above5% relative to baseline-robust.
claim_gate.reference_gate: Mean G >=0 against EACH of the two complete paired robust native references in EACH task/learner stratum; no selecting the easier reference after results.
claim_gate.failure_gate: Failures, RSS kills, timeouts, incomplete pairs, unsupported tasks, budget skips and missing/nonfinite losses block broad claims. Report all planned denominators; no successful-case-only promotion.
claim_gate.zero_denominator: No artificial epsilon or family deletion. Zero/nonfinite reference losses make the relative gate indeterminate; report absolute losses and block automatic passage.
claim_gate.win_tie_loss: Per family/learner/reference: win if G>1%, loss if G<-1%, tie otherwise.

intervals.method: Descriptive paired family-block percentile intervals, seed2028,10000 resamples,95% level.
intervals.limits: Only three classification families and one regression family. No between-family regression confidence interval can be estimated from one family; do not bootstrap folds as independent families or claim significance.

claim_gate.scope: Four predetermined observational source families, including ONE regression origin. This can only test a narrowly defined held-out cohort; it cannot establish broad SOTA, general regression superiority, cross-modality leadership or default promotion.
claim_gate.resources: Report expected/successful/failed cells and complete paired families per method/task/learner, elapsed active time, per-cell timing, peak RSS and remaining budget.
